outcome: Complications (pulmonary edema, medical termination of pregnancy, hypothyroidism, hepatitis B infection, pneumonia, postprocedural delivery, severe mitral regurgitation)
cohort: 117 pregnant women who underwent PBMV for rheumatic mitral stenosis
finding: PBMV in pregnant women with rheumatic mitral stenosis was safe and effective, resulting in improved hemodynamics and favorable maternal and short-term neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Term birth and mode of delivery were significantly associated with pregnancy and neonatal outcomes.
birth_weight: Birth weight was significantly associated with pregnancy and neonatal outcomes.
